audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly writes 'his Q/W CC' — treating Unstable Matter (W) as a crowd-control ability.
audit.why: Unstable Matter has no CC at all: it explodes outward on a flat 5s cooldown and deals a percentage of your maximum health as magic damage. Zac's CC is Stretching Strikes (Q, grab and throw) and Let's Bounce! (R, four knock-ups). Calling W crowd control makes a player fear the wrong button and miss the one that is actually shredding a low-HP marksman standing next to him.
audit.corrected: W now stated as percent-max-health damage; CC attributed to Q and R.
sources: brief enemyKit W text + percentHealth flag, cd 5

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart disagreed with the already-audited mirror at two rows: this page had Levels 4-5 as Skill and Level 6 as Lucian, while zac__lucian records the chart as Lucian / Lucian / Lucian / Lucian / Skill / Skill / Zac. The full layer also labels the matchup HARD while breakdown.difficulty and report[14] call it a favoured 4/10.
audit.why: Reusing the mirror's finding rather than re-litigating it: Lucian's poke stays ahead through 4-5 because Elastic Slingshot is a 21s cooldown at rank 1, and Level 6 is genuinely even — Let's Bounce! is a real all-in but only lands with Relentless Pursuit down.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 set to Lucian and Level 6 to Skill in both layers, matching the mirror exactly; diff token set to EVEN so it stops contradicting its own 4/10 rating.

audit.why: The Levels 4-5 row is Lucian's because Elastic Slingshot's 21s rank-1 cooldown leaves long free windows, and Level 6 is even rather than Lucian's because Let's Bounce! chains four knock-ups.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is a trailing clause on the itemization line and never appears where the sustain is actually described.
audit.why: Cell Division sheds reabsorbable blobs on every ability hit, so Grievous Wounds is what makes poke stick; and because both the passive and Unstable Matter deal or scale on health rather than being blunted by resistances, armour alone reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds now named in mid, where the sustain problem is described.
sources: brief enemyKit P text, heal + percentHealth flags

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Elastic Slingshot — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — that downtime is a long free window, so chip him every time it is spent.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Let's Bounce! chains four knock-ups — the stage is even, and your dash is what decides it.

edits.before: Zac whiffs Elastic Slingshot and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Unstable Matter is percent-max-HP every 5s — never stand beside him.

edits.before: His blob sustain catches up to your poke and his mana-free trades hold even — the edge slips back to a coin-flip.
edits.after: His blob sustain closes the gap, but your double-shot chip still out-paces it while Elastic Slingshot is down.

edits.before: At 6 his R knock-up into Q/W CC out-all-ins your low base HP whenever your E reset is on cooldown.
edits.after: At 6 Let's Bounce! evens it — four knock-ups kill you if your dash is down, so hold Relentless Pursuit.

edits.before: Zac's HP item makes your Q/Lightslinger trades chip nothing while his Q/W CC sticks you — the lane flips here.
edits.after: Zac's HP item makes your trades chip nothing while Stretching Strikes sticks you and Unstable Matter grinds.

edits.before: Use W's move-speed mark and E dash to kite his Q/W CC and never get slung into his team
edits.after: Use W's move-speed mark and E dash to dodge Stretching Strikes, never get slung in

edits.before: The lane starts slipping here. Your poke still stings but his blob sustain undoes it between trades, and at 6 his R becomes a real all-in: knock-up into Q/W CC will catch you if your E (Relentless Pursuit) isn't up to dash out. Hold your E for his engage, not for chasing. You can still win a clean short trade with the Lightslinger burst, but stop forcing extended fights — every second he stays on you, his CC and blob HP win.
edits.after: The lane starts slipping here. Your poke still stings but his blob sustain undoes it between trades, so Grievous Wounds is a real buy. At 6 Let's Bounce! becomes an all-in: four knock-ups that catch you whenever Relentless Pursuit isn't up to dash out. Hold E for his engage, not for chasing. You can still win a clean short trade, but stop forcing extended ones — every second beside him, Unstable Matter burns percent-max-HP.

edits.before: This is lost for you in a straight fight. Once Zac has even one HP item your Q and double-shots barely dent him while his Q/W CC and E sling pin you down, and your Culling channel gets wasted the moment he disengages or revives off his blobs. You are a weak scaler and he is a tank — accept it. Roam, use your early lead (if you got one) to take other lanes, and never get caught alone where he can sling you into his team.
edits.after: This is lost for you in a straight fight. Once Zac has even one HP item your double-shots barely dent him, Stretching Strikes and Elastic Slingshot pin you down, and Unstable Matter takes percent-max-HP off you every five seconds while he revives off his blobs. You are a weak scaler and he is a tank — accept it. Roam, spend your early lead on other lanes, and never get caught alone where he can sling you in.

notes: The kit file flags Zac's Elastic Slingshot with 'grounding — shuts off enemy dashes'. Riot's own description ('attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward') says nothing of the kind, and the flag looks like tooltip parsing catching the word 'ground'. Per the rule about flags contradicting the description I trusted the description and wrote nothing about Relentless Pursuit being grounded — but if that flag is real it changes this matchup completely, because the entire page tells the reader to hold E for his engage. Worth a human check. Chart rows here were taken from the already-audited mirror (zac__lucian) rather than the packet, which disagreed at Levels 4-5 and 6.
